'''Eric Vonlick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for sabotage, murder, theft and treason. He was last seen in [[Zakuul]] lower city and his wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eric Vonlick appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
